P.name: Way of the Hunter
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Intent:}} '''Yone's''' {{as|{{sti|'''total''' critical strike chance}}}} is doubled from all other sources. Additionally,{{ft|every {{as|1% critical strike chance}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.5}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.|every {{as|50% critical strike chance}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{sti|{{as|25 '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.}}
P.description2: '''Yone's''' {{tip|critically strike|critical strikes}} deal only{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Yone|crit_base}}|100|mod={{ccd|Yone|crit_mod}}}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.|{{fd|{{#expr:{{ccd|Yone|crit_mod}}*100}}}}% of the {{sti|{{as|critical damage}}}} champions usually have.}}
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Steel and Spirit:}} '''Yone's''' {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} alternate between his {{as|Steel Sword|Steel}} and {{as|Azakana Sword|azakana}} {{tip|on-attack}}. '''Yone''' begins attacking with {{as|Steel Sword|Steel}}, and basic attacks with {{as|Azakana Sword|azakana}} deal {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|50% AD}} {{as|magic damage}}.

Q.name: Mortal Steel
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yone''' thrusts his {{as|Steel Sword}} in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the first enemy hit. ''Mortal Steel's'' damage based on its {{as|AD ratio}} can {{tip|critically strike}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|25 to 125}} {{as|(+ 110% AD)}}|Critical Strike Damage|{{ap|25 to 125}} {{as|(+ {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Yone|crit_base}}*1.1|110|mod={{ccd|Yone|crit_mod}}}}|critical damage}} AD)|ad}}}}
Q.description2: If this hits at least one enemy, '''Yone''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Gathering Storm'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next ''Mortal Steel'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Gathering Storm Bonus:}} '''Yone''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed distance in the target direction and unleashes a whirlwind in the same direction, both applying and triggering the same effects and additionally {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies hit in their path for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, but being unable to affect the same target twice.
Q.description4: ''Mortal Steel's'' thrust will fail to hit targets after the cast time if '''Yone''' was affected by {{tip|disarming crowd control}} during it, but the {{sti|cooldown}} of the ability is reset to {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
Q.static: {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|4 to 1.48 for 8;4/3|key1=%|0 to 105;1000/9|formula=4*(1-(0.01 per 1.67% '''bonus''' attack speed)). ''This is capped at 67% reduction at 111.1% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}
Q.cast time: {{tt|{{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|round=3|0.35;0.33;0.297;0.264;0.231;0.198;0.175|key1=%|0;13.72;36.358;58.996;81.634;104.272;120|formula=0.35-0.035 per 24% '''bonus''' attack speed. ''This is capped at 50% reduction at 120% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}|Both thrust and whirlwind cast times}}

W.name: Spirit Cleave
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yone'''  cleaves with his {{as|Azakana Sword|azakana}} in a cone in the target direction, dealing equal parts {{as|physical|physical damage}} and {{as|magic|magic damage}} damage to enemies hit. The '''total''' mixed damage has a minimum threshold of {{pp|30+10*x for 8;then + 20*x for 5;then + 40*x for 7|formula=30 + 10 per level until lvl 8, then + 20 per level until lvl 13, then + 40 per level}} against {{tip|minions}} and a maximum threshold of {{pp|140+10*x for 20|formula=140 + 10 per level}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling: {{st|Total Mixed Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8 to 12}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Physical Damage|{{ap|5 to 25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8/2 to 12/2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Magic Damage|{{ap|5 to 25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|8/2 to 12/2}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description2: If this hits an enemy, '''Yone''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|40 + (90-40)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ 65% '''bonus''' AD)}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, increased by 100% if it hits a {{tip|champion}} and by 50% for each subsequent champion hit.
W.cast time: {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|0.5 to 0.1875 for 11|key1=%|0 to 105|formula=0.5*(1-(0.01 per 1.68% '''bonus''' attack speed)). ''This is capped at 62.5% reduction at 105% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}
W.static: {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|14 to 6 for 11|key1=%|0 to 94.553|formula=14*(1-(0.01 per 1.51% '''bonus''' attack speed)). ''This is capped at 62.5% reduction at 94.6% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}

E.name: Soul Unbound
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yone''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the target direction, including through terrain, discarding his body and entering ''Spirit Form'' for 5 seconds. '''Yone's''' body is {{tip|untargetable}} and is sent the same distance behind the cast location, though not through terrain, and is reclaimed when ''Soul Unbound'' ends.
E.description2: {{sbc|Spirit Form:}} '''Yone''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10 to 30 for 11|0 to 3|key=%|type=seconds active|label1=seconds since the start of the initial dash|label=bonus movement speed}} '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. His damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against enemy champions apply a mark that stores a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}} dealt to the target by his attacks and abilities.
E.description3: Activation resets ''{{ais|Way of the Hunter|Yone}}'' current sword state. ''Soul Unbound'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and automatically does so after the duration.
E.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Yone''' {{tip|dashes}} back to his body with {{tip|displacement immunity}}, ending ''Spirit Form'' and consuming the marks on each champion to deal {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} equal to the total amount of damage stored against each of them.
E.description5: ''The automatic recast is delayed if '''Yone''' is {{tip|attack windup|winding up}} a basic attack or is unable to recast Soul Unbound under any circumstances, which includes if he cannot move or cast abilities. Soul Unbound will also immediately recast upon {{tip|death}} or entering {{tip|resurrection}}.''

R.name: Fate Sealed
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yone''' prepares a strike over the cast time, then ''marks'' all enemies within an area in the target direction, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second. He {{tip|blinks}} {{tt|200 units|Can place him beyond maximum range}} beyond the center of the last enemy {{tip|champion}} struck, or else to {{tt|maximum range|Uses center range}} instead.
R.description2: After {{tt|{{fd|0.3}} seconds|From the end of the cast time}}, a gust rushes along the same area that deals equal parts {{as|physical|pdamage}} and {{as|magic|mdamage}} damage to ''marked'' enemies within and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them towards the location '''Yone''' blinked to, then {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
R.leveling2: {{st|Total Mixed Damage|{{ap|200 to 600}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 300}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 300}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
